# What should you charge for a mobile welding job?

> Free mobile welding job price calculator: on-site and drive hours, pay, rig, consumables, truck miles, materials and target margin in; a job price, travel-distance table, overrun check and break-even jobs per month out. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
